SMART_FEATURES.TITLE: Smart features
SMART_FEATURES.DESCRIPTION: Extra tools that save time and protect your WhatsApp number. Each one has its own switch, and all are off until you turn them on.
SMART_FEATURES.ERROR: Could not save. Please try again.
SMART_FEATURES.ALL_OPTIONAL: Turn on only what you need. {count} turned on.

TYPING_INDICATOR.TITLE: Show "typing..." while the AI writes
TYPING_INDICATOR.HINT: On WhatsApp the customer sees "typing..." and their message as read while the AI prepares the reply.

RETURNING_CUSTOMERS.TITLE: Remember returning customers
RETURNING_CUSTOMERS.HINT: The AI knows a customer's earlier chats, orders and appointments, and welcomes them back.

PAYMENT_CHECK.TITLE: Check payment screenshots
PAYMENT_CHECK.HINT: When a customer sends a JazzCash, Easypaisa or bank screenshot, the AI reads the amount and transaction ID and leaves a private note for your team. The customer sees nothing.

PHOTO_SEARCH.TITLE: Find products from photos
PHOTO_SEARCH.HINT: When a customer sends a photo of something they want, the AI finds the closest products in your catalog and shows them with price and picture. Needs the catalog turned on.

FOLLOW_UP.TITLE: Follow up with quiet customers
FOLLOW_UP.HINT: If a customer goes quiet after the AI answered (for example after asking a price), the AI sends one short follow-up. Only inside the 24-hour reply window, and never more than once.

REVIEW_REQUEST.TITLE: Ask for a rating
REVIEW_REQUEST.HINT: When an order is marked delivered or an appointment done, the customer is asked to rate it from 1 to 5. Happy customers get your Google review link; unhappy ones are flagged for your team.

COD_CONFIRM.TITLE: Confirm COD orders on WhatsApp
COD_CONFIRM.HINT: New Shopify or WooCommerce orders come into ChatsSync, and the customer gets your WhatsApp template with Confirm and Cancel buttons. The order updates on its own when they tap. Meta charges for each template message.

AD_REPORT.TITLE: Ad report
AD_REPORT.HINT: See which Facebook and Instagram ads brought chats, orders, bookings and sales in the last 30 days. Counts chats that start from a Click-to-WhatsApp ad.

META_SALES.TITLE: Send sales to Meta
META_SALES.HINT: When an order from an ad chat reaches the status you choose, ChatsSync tells Meta about the sale, so your ads find more people who buy. Only the amount and Meta's ad click code are sent.

DAILY_REPORT.TITLE: Daily report by email
DAILY_REPORT.HINT: Every morning at 9 you get yesterday's chats, AI replies, orders, appointments and the chats still waiting for a reply.

HEALTH_GUARD.TITLE: WhatsApp number health
HEALTH_GUARD.HINT: See each number's quality rating and daily message limit from Meta, and get an email when quality drops.

STOP_OPT_OUT.TITLE: STOP to unsubscribe
STOP_OPT_OUT.HINT: A customer who sends STOP stops getting broadcasts, and START brings them back. This keeps your number's quality high.

COD.NO_TEMPLATES: No approved template with two quick reply buttons on this number yet. Create one in WhatsApp Manager (first button Confirm, second Cancel), then refresh this page.

COD.HELP_WOO: WooCommerce: Settings > Advanced > Webhooks > Add webhook. Topic: Order created, then paste this link as the Delivery URL.
COD.LINK_PRIVATE: Keep this link private. Anyone who has it can send orders to your account.
